paragraphs: EduTrak sells business software to K-12 school districts, written for both the staff who run school operations and the parents who pay school bills. Tuition, childcare, ticketing and eStore purchases are handled through a single sign-on.

The modules include tuition payments, food service accounts where a student's lunch money is added and tracked, online payments for school events and ticket sales, and registration for school programs. The company says those pieces fit together into one system rather than standing apart. On the administrative side, school business officials can review payments in one central place, organized by account code and department code.

EduTrak describes its technology as in use at dozens of schools and service organizations across North America. A prospective district begins with a discovery meeting, then a demonstration and a written proposal covering the systems, modules and transition steps. The company states that securing customer data and payments drives its work.

quote.text: School districts deserve easier, more straightforward software enabling employees to do their jobs more efficiently while making parents’ lives easier.
